mapper.sql: SELECT sr.id,sr.task_id,sr.run_id,tr.run_no,tr.status AS run_status,t.task_no,t.task_name,COALESCE(s.application,r.application) AS application,COALESCE(s.version_no,r.version_no) AS version_no,r.repository_name,sr.scanned_files,sr.success_files,sr.failed_files,sr.issue_count,sr.high_count,sr.medium_count,sr.low_count,sr.info_count,sr.operator_user_id,sr.operator_user_name,sr.create_time FROM scan_result sr JOIN scan_task_run tr ON tr.id=sr.run_id JOIN scan_task t ON t.id=sr.task_id JOIN code_repository r ON r.id=t.repository_id LEFT JOIN task_snapshot s ON s.id=tr.task_snapshot_id
mapper.select: WHERE sr.task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY sr.id DESC LIMIT 1
ORDER BY sr.create_time DESC,sr.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM scan_result sr JOIN scan_task_run tr ON tr.id=sr.run_id JOIN scan_task t ON t.id=sr.task_id JOIN code_repository r ON r.id=t.repository_id LEFT JOIN task_snapshot s ON s.id=tr.task_snapshot_id
mapper.sql: SELECT i.id,i.result_id,i.task_id,i.run_id,i.execution_unit_id,i.result_commit_key,i.repository_id,i.rule_id,i.title,i.risk_level,i.rule_type,i.file_path,i.start_line,i.end_line,i.matched_content,i.context_content,i.issue_description,i.suggestion,i.status,i.handle_comment,i.handler,i.operator_user_id,i.operator_user_name,i.handle_time,i.create_time,t.task_no,t.task_name,COALESCE(snap.application,cur.application,r.application) AS application,COALESCE(snap.version_no,cur.version_no,r.version_no) AS version_no,r.repository_name,rule.rule_name FROM scan_issue i JOIN scan_task t ON t.id=i.task_id JOIN code_repository r ON r.id=i.repository_id JOIN scan_rule rule ON rule.id=i.rule_id LEFT JOIN scan_task_run tr ON tr.id=i.run_id LEFT JOIN task_snapshot snap ON snap.id=tr.task_snapshot_id LEFT JOIN task_snapshot cur ON cur.id=t.current_snapshot_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY i.create_time DESC,i.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM scan_issue i JOIN scan_task t ON t.id=i.task_id JOIN code_repository r ON r.id=i.repository_id LEFT JOIN scan_task_run tr ON tr.id=i.run_id LEFT JOIN task_snapshot snap ON snap.id=tr.task_snapshot_id LEFT JOIN task_snapshot cur ON cur.id=t.current_snapshot_id
ORDER BY i.create_time DESC,i.id DESC LIMIT 50000
mapper.update: UPDATE scan_result SET scanned_files=(SELECT completed_files FROM scan_task WHERE id=#{taskId}),success_files=(SELECT success_files FROM scan_task WHERE id=#{taskId}),failed_files=(SELECT failed_files FROM scan_task WHERE id=#{taskId}),issue_count=(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM scan_issue WHERE task_id=#{taskId}),high_count=(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM scan_issue WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND risk_level='HIGH'),medium_count=(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM scan_issue WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND risk_level='MEDIUM'),low_count=(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM scan_issue WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND risk_level='LOW'),info_count=(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM scan_issue WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND risk_level='INFO') WHERE task_id=#{taskId}
